name: Millenium MPS-850
notes: Basic pad mappings verified from this user’s MPS-850 observations on 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25, all on channel 10. Snare D1=38 anchors MIDI Monitor’s octave naming: closed/open/pedal hi-hat F#1/A#1/G#1=42/46/44; Tom 1–4 C2/A1/G1/F1=48/45/43/41; Crash 1–2 C#2/A2=49/57. Kick 36 and ride 59 were previously confirmed in the app. Rims and separate cymbal bow/edge/bell mappings are excluded at the user’s request. Pedal Control/Aftertouch messages are not scoring hits. This profile verifies basic note mappings on this kit, not end-to-end latency, full practice acceptance, or universal factory defaults.
